title: Chapter 1140
paragraphs: Chapter 1140
Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (9)
Hwaaaaaa...!
The sun energy that had left Kelliark was being released in all directions. The power of Kinzelo was no longer his.

The sun energy soared and fell indiscriminately, striking the ground. Jin's light was blocking most of the sun energy, but he couldn't do anything about the sun energy that spread beyond the battlefield.
That sun energy, following the will of Malugia, who had begun to operate again, would destroy this world without a trace.
"To defeat you, the power of the Sun God is not too dear a price."
"You lunatic..."
"The 677th dimension will soon disappear completely. Let's settle this before then. Who will be the one standing at the end?"
A ball of red flame was fired from Kelliark's staff. Jin rushed forward, cutting through the flame with his sword, but he calmly received Jin's sword.
When Jin was perceived as light, it was the speed of light; otherwise, it was just a sword striking down.
It was still fast and heavy, but it couldn't be compared to when he was perceived as light. Kelliark swung his staff to push Jin away and fired a beam at his chest.
"I've been dealing with you too cautiously all this time, Jin Runcandel. But it was worth it. I was able to cast off the worthless vanity of becoming a one true god."
Kaang-!

The beam was blocked by Barisada and deflected. Jin gritted his teeth, stabilized himself in a low-floating position, and once again swung his sword at the forehead of Kelliark, who had approached in an instant.
The tip of the sword grazed his forehead.
But Kelliark no longer used the power of the Origin Stone. If he did, Jin would once again appear as a ball of light in his eyes.
"Jin!"
It was Veradin. He and Dante were clutching the wounds they had inflicted on each other and rushing towards Jin.
And Murakan, Hedo, Luna, Luntia, Syris, and Yona formed an encirclement.

No one else was in a state to fight. Even Chiron and Vahn couldn't get up from their collapsed state. In fact, even those who were coming to help Jin now were at a level where it wouldn't be strange for them to collapse at any moment.

Not a single person was left in the Demon Army to support Kelliark. The white fleet had been completely destroyed without a single ship remaining, and all forces, including the Genesis Knights, had already fallen in battle.
"Yes, all of you who can move, come at me! There's no land to return to anyway. I will remember you."
A formation was established with Jin at its center.

Light-Speed Thrust. Jin's secret technique was the first to aim for Kelliark's heart. He parried the sword ki and instead closed the distance with Jin, and in that time, Yona's sword shallowly cut his side.
He too was tired.

He had effectively fought the entire Vamel Alliance alone all this time, had defeated transcendent beings including Heluram and Malugia, and had massacred over ninety percent of all life in the world.
And now, he had to fight while also blocking the beams being fired from the sun energy he had just discarded. Jin was not about to block the sun energy that was falling on him.
Kelliark struck Yona down with his fist. Yona, slammed into the ground and coughing up blood, still tried to grab his ankle.
If Krantel hadn't struck down on Kelliark's shoulder then, Yona's head would have been crushed by Kelliark's stomp.
"Die!"
Krantel, swung with a hoarse shout, was blocked by the staff. But at that moment, a stray sun energy beam struck Kelliark's back.
Jin didn't miss that opening and dug in, stabbing Barisada at his neck. Blocked by the side of his hand, Barisada fell to the floor and cut his ankle instead of his neck.
In that time, Murakan transformed one of his arms into its true form and struck Kelliark, and Dante's Rashid and Veradin's flame orb aimed for him as his body was momentarily lifted into the air.

Blocked by a shield, they couldn't inflict damage. But then, Luntia, squeezing out all her remaining strength, stabbed with her thin sword, Charle, which pierced the shield, and after confirming that one side of the shield was broken, she lost consciousness.
It was Syris who put her sword into the crack. The pure white blade of Myriad Ice pierced Kelliark's back.
The eyes of everyone watching widened.
It was near his heart. Even without using the Origin Stone, Kelliark had been continuously regenerating, but now he wasn't, being conscious of the power of light.
"Hmph!"
P-grrk, pok...!
Kelliark showed the monstrous strength to grab the blade of Myriad Ice that had come out through his chest and crush it. Cyris retrieved the broken Myriad Ice, and Kelliark tried to grab her head.
Hedo's sword cut that arm. The blade dug into his skin and stopped, caught on the bone.
Kelliark roughly pushed him away and threw the sword stuck in his arm. A scene followed where all his comrades, except for the unconscious Luntia, rushed at him again.
We can win.
At this rate, we might really be able to defeat him. Jin and all his comrades harbored such a feeling. Kelliark, unlike before, was continuously allowing attacks.
"You're right, Jin Runcandel. I must have been crazy, trying to become a one true god when I had such a fun fight before me."
He was laughing like an excited child.

He was laughing alone among the desperate. With a heart that wished this fight would continue forever, but with a mind that knew better than anyone that it couldn't, Kelliark briskly closed the distance with Jin.
Taking the sun energy that was pouring down like rain with his whole body, and while blocking the sword ki fired by Jin and his comrades, he was already becoming covered in blood.
His hair was disheveled and flying like a beggar's, and in his blood-soaked face, his two eyes were strangely brilliant.
There was no time to answer. Jin and his comrades had reached a point where their eyes would automatically squeeze shut every time they swung their swords.
Their consciousness cut out and returned repeatedly. Luntia too suddenly shot up and tried to extend her sword before collapsing again.
They couldn't even tell how the fight was flowing. They were just vaguely swinging their swords at Kelliark, who looked like a ball of light in their hazy vision.
Sometimes, something would catch on their blades. Whether it was Kelliark's arm, leg, head, or just the ground, they couldn't tell, but there was something that was catching.
Around that time, Jin felt the power of light fading.
'No, if the light disappears, people will start dying again...'
Without the light, he couldn't block the indiscriminately pouring sun energy. But for some reason, the sun energy was now falling not on the battlefield and the world, but solely on Kelliark.
Jin and his comrades just hadn't noticed; it had been that way for a while now.
Jin, who had belatedly looked up at the sky, realized that fact. Why had the sun energy started to target only Kelliark, not the people and the world?
There was only one reason.
'Lady Elona...? Is that you?'
The whole sun energy, the remaining will of Malugia within it, and Elona.

With the hands that had mercilessly killed people as a slave of the Zipples, Elona was now struggling to save people. With the single-minded determination that even if she couldn't stop the world's destruction, she had to save the people fighting here, she had to save Veradin.
Kelliark was staggering from the sun energy that was continuously striking him down.
The staff he had been holding also fell to the floor. Now, not even blood was flowing from his body.
Kelliark didn't pick up the Origin Stone that had fallen to the floor and approached Jin.
The power of light had completely disappeared from Jin as well. He too, like Kelliark, paid no mind and swung Barisada.
His sense of distance was gone, and the sword cut through the air and fell to the ground. But Jin got up again and pointed his sword at Kelliark just the same.
Now, he couldn't even coat his blade with a thin sword energy. But Kelliark had no shield either.
When he stopped, one step away from Jin.

He had holes in his body larger than his fists, and only one eye was left. It was the result of being stabbed dozens of times by the swords of Jin and his comrades and being crushed by the sun energy.
And yet, he was standing.
"As expected... you don't back down in the end."
Kelliark's cracked voice was heard.
Jin couldn't understand him.

Neither his empty desire to conquer all dimensions, nor the reason why he was so strong, nor the reason why he was fighting him now even after abandoning the sun energy and the Origin Stone, nor the reason why he was smiling as if satisfied, broken beyond recovery.
He couldn't understand anything.
"I'll ask just one thing... Kelliark Zipfel."
"What is it?"
"Why... didn't you run away...?"
If Kelliark had run away instead of abandoning the sun energy and the Origin Stone.
If he had just opened a dimensional gate and fled somewhere to buy time until the power of light disappeared from Jin.
He would have surely won. Kelliark had clearly seen through the fact that the authority of light that had appeared in Jin would soon disappear.
Even if Jin had chased him into the dimensional passage, Jin would have eventually lost the power of light and been trapped inside.
Puk...!
Barisada pierced Kelliark's forehead. Kelliark looked down at Jin with the sword pierced through his head.
And he grabbed Jin's neck with both hands.
No one could protect Jin from him. Even those who had fought to the end had all lost consciousness.
"When the finite has a higher value than the infinite, what reason would I have to defeat you in such a pathetic way?"
"What...?"

"The fight was already won by me the moment the red sea first flooded. At that time, the 677th dimension had already met an irreversible end. Even if a few of you survive here, when will you all be able to fill this world with life again? It would probably take a few thousand years."
Jin felt Kelliark's grasp on his neck tightening.
But just as he was about to lose his breath, the grasp loosened.
A moment later, Jin was watching Kelliark's body scatter into particles.
"You all will forget me someday, Jin Runcandel. But I will remember you forever. And when that time comes, I might appear again. On a day when everyone has forgotten today..."
Clank...!
Barisada, which had been piercing Kelliark's forehead, fell to the floor.
"Heok, heok...!"

Jin, letting out ragged, blood-mixed breaths, looked back at the spot where he had been standing several times. It was hard to believe, even after seeing it with his own eyes, that he had finally met his end.
Soon, Jin sat down and looked around.
He could see his fallen comrades and the sun energy that had stopped moving. What was left were the people who had survived the fight and...
The world that had finally met its end.
In the midst of the vagueness, a dimensional gate suddenly opened before his eyes.
"Jin Runcandel..."
The voice that was heard was that of Octavia Zipfel.
